title: BANDAGE PICK-UPS AND SAVE MEDAL
why: His g-58, g-60, g-62 and g-66: bandages speed a confirmed pick-up, its bleed clock holds, a sharper alert at five seconds, and risky saves earn a medal. Watch: a reviver may spend a bandage wanted for healing; a pick-up started with one second left can finish; distinguish the late alert from clock ticks and the machine siren; watch save medal frequency near machines.
now: A carried bandage halves the base pick-up hold and is spent only when the teammate stands up. Fresh nearby revive state pauses bleed time. One six-note alert per fall at five seconds. Confirmed risky saves award the tier-two save medal and 150 sp. Existing medic gear still applies.
